items.question: Is this AI resume builder really free?
items.answer: Yes! You can create, edit, and preview your resume completely free. We offer premium plans for advanced features like unlimited PDF downloads and additional templates, but you can build a professional resume without paying anything.

items.question: What is an ATS and why does it matter?
items.answer: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is software used by 99% of Fortune 500 companies to scan and filter resumes. Our AI ensures your resume is ATS-optimized with the right keywords, formatting, and structure to pass these automated screenings.

items.question: How does the AI help write my resume?
items.answer: Our AI analyzes your job title and experience to generate professional bullet points, summaries, and skill suggestions. It uses industry-specific keywords and achievement-focused language that recruiters look for.

items.question: Do I need to sign up to use the builder?
items.answer: No signup required to start building! You can create your entire resume first. Only sign up when you want to save your progress or download. This lets you try everything risk-free.

items.question: Can I download my resume as a PDF?
items.answer: Yes! Export your resume as a pixel-perfect PDF that looks exactly like the preview. PDFs are optimized for both digital applications and printing on standard letter/A4 paper.

items.question: How long does it take to create a resume?
items.answer: Most users create a professional resume in under 10 minutes. Our AI suggestions and pre-written content speed up the process significantly compared to starting from scratch.

cancelAnytime.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancelAnytime.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time, including during your free trial. You won't be charged if you cancel before the trial ends.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) via Stripe. PayPal coming soon.

starterOneTime.question: How does the free trial work?
starterOneTime.answer: All plans come with a 7-day free trial. Add your card to start, and you won't be charged until the trial ends. During the trial, you have daily limits on AI resume generation.

runOutDownloads.question: What happens when I reach my limits?
runOutDownloads.answer: When you reach your monthly CV creation or AI generation limit, you can upgrade to a higher plan for more capacity. Limits reset at the start of each billing period.

switchPlans.question: Can I switch between plans?
switchPlans.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and we'll prorate any charges.

refunds.question: Do you offer refunds?
refunds.answer: Since all plans include a 7-day free trial, we don't offer refunds after you're charged. Make sure to cancel during your trial if it's not right for you.
